# Golden Path Requirements Checklist: Live Routing Golden Path

**Purpose**: Requirements-quality review of live catalog fetch, classification, cheaper-first selection, inspectable mixes, failover, freshness, and named-check execution. Not an implementation test plan.
**Created**: 2026-08-30
**Feature**: [spec.md](../spec.md)

**Note**: This custom checklist is generated by the `$speckit-checklist` command based on feature context and requirements.
**Review Ownership**: This checklist is a reviewer-owned requirements-quality review artifact. Mark an item `[x]` only when the reviewer determines the requirements-quality criterion is satisfied. Intended for the author before `/speckit-tasks` and for peers on spec/PR review.
**Marker Semantics**: `[x]` means the criterion has been reviewed and satisfied for requirements quality. It does not mean implementation work is complete.

## Requirement Completeness

- [x] CHK001 Are live catalog fetch and live execution of the named check both required for a golden-path pass, with fixture catalogs limited to classification-rule tests? [Completeness, Spec §US5, FR-014, FR-015]
- [x] CHK002 Is the live surface defined as a real gateway or provider that both lists identities and executes the chosen identity? [Completeness, Spec §Discovery model, FR-014]
- [x] CHK003 Are published specification fields that must be fetched enumerated (identity, cost class, context/output limits, tools, modalities)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001b, Clarifications]
- [x] CHK004 Is guessing from names, aliases, or keyword task detection explicitly forbidden for every pending attribute, not only cost? [Completeness, Spec §FR-001b]
- [x] CHK005 Is cheaper-vs-paid selection specified for both a single identity and a mix whose first remaining qualified step is paid? [Completeness, Spec §FR-005, FR-001e]
- [x] CHK006 Are drop reasons required for every excluded candidate, including unclassified, stale, opaque mix, policy, health, and capability? [Completeness, Spec §FR-004, data-model Candidate]
- [x] CHK007 Is the named check specified as a pre-stated artifact plus an independent checker, not an unchecked model reply? [Completeness, Spec §US4, FR-011]
- [x] CHK008 Are explanation and receipt contents specified, including what must never appear (secrets, prompts, completions)? [Completeness, Spec §FR-009, FR-010, FR-013]

## Requirement Clarity

- [x] CHK009 Is “blocked” versus “passed” defined so an unreachable live surface cannot be reported as success? [Clarity, Spec §US5 AC3, FR-015, SC-005]
- [x] CHK010 Is “cheaper / free / local / paid” defined as a fetched cost class rather than alias branding? [Clarity, Spec §Discovery model, FR-001b]
- [x] CHK011 Is “unclassified” defined as any required spec field missing or outside the freshness window? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001c, FR-001f]
- [x] CHK012 Is a mix distinguished from a concrete identity and from an opaque automatic picker in language a non-developer can use? [Clarity, Spec §Discovery model, FR-001a, FR-001d]
- [x] CHK013 Is mix cost class defined as the first remaining qualified step that would actually run, not a later cheaper step? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001e]
- [x] CHK014 Is “this-run capture or operator-declared freshness window” specific enough that identity-name match cannot override staleness? [Clarity, Spec §FR-001f]
- [x] CHK015 Is failover order explicit: cheaper unused qualified identities first, paid only after that set is empty, no same-identity retry? [Clarity, Spec §FR-011a]

## Requirement Consistency

- [x] CHK016 Do US5 / FR-014 / FR-015 / SC-005 agree that fixture-only success is vaporware and live fetch+execute is required? [Consistency, Spec §US5]
- [x] CHK017 Does failover including paid (clarify Q4) still forbid selecting paid while a cheaper unused qualified identity remains (FR-005)? [Consistency, Spec §FR-005, FR-011a]
- [x] CHK018 Are Core-as-policy-authority and gateway-as-executor consistent across spec, plan, and contract? [Consistency, Spec §Discovery model, plan.md]
- [x] CHK019 Is degraded/provided-catalog language fully removed or explicitly demoted so it cannot satisfy the demo? [Consistency, Spec §US5, FR-015, Assumptions]
- [x] CHK020 Does “catalog membership is not qualification” stay consistent with probe/health rules in US1? [Consistency, Spec §US1, FR-002, FR-003]

## Acceptance Criteria Quality

- [x] CHK021 Can SC-001 (100% exclusion of denied/unhealthy/unqualified on repeated same inputs) be measured without implementation access? [Measurability, Spec §SC-001]
- [x] CHK022 Can SC-002 (0% paid use when a cheaper kept candidate exists) be measured from the receipt? [Measurability, Spec §SC-002]
- [x] CHK023 Can SC-003 (non-developer explanation in under 5 minutes) be scored without source code? [Measurability, Spec §SC-003]
- [x] CHK024 Can SC-004 require a live selected identity and a known checker, not a fixture pass? [Measurability, Spec §SC-004, FR-014]
- [x] CHK025 Can SC-005 be failed honestly when the live surface is down (blocked, not skipped-as-green)? [Measurability, Spec §SC-005]
- [x] CHK026 Can SC-006 determinism be checked on the keep/drop set and cheaper-vs-paid decision for the same live catalog capture? [Measurability, Spec §SC-006]

## Scenario Coverage

- [x] CHK027 Are primary-flow requirements complete for discover → fetch specs → classify → probe → select → explain → live named check → receipt? [Coverage, Spec §US1–US4]
- [x] CHK028 Are exception-flow requirements defined for empty catalog, all unclassified, opaque mix, checker fail, and exhaustion? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases, contract errors]
- [x] CHK029 Are recovery-flow requirements defined for cheaper-first failover including paid after cheaper unused identities are gone? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011a]
- [x] CHK030 Is the unreachable-live-surface scenario specified as blocked rather than as an alternate success path? [Coverage, Spec §US5]
- [x] CHK031 Are dual-use fixtures specified so rule tests cannot be labeled as the golden-path demonstration? [Coverage, Spec §US5 AC4, FR-015]

## Edge Case Coverage

- [x] CHK032 Are identity conflicts (same display name, different live identity) required to fail closed? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK033 Is a cheaper-but-too-slow candidate specified relative to a stated time bound, not left as “maybe paid”? [Coverage, Spec §Edge Cases]
- [x] CHK034 Is a mix with a paid first remaining step and a cheaper later step specified as paid? [Coverage, Spec §FR-001e]
- [x] CHK035 Is retry of the same identity forbidden even after a transient execute error? [Coverage, Spec §FR-011a]
- [x] CHK036 Is a catalog that lists identities but cannot execute the named check specified as blocked for the demo, not a pass on listing alone? [Gap, Spec §US5, FR-014]

## Non-Functional & Safety

- [x] CHK037 Are secrets, credentials, prompts, completions, and raw tool arguments forbidden on explanations and receipts? [Completeness, Spec §FR-010]
- [x] CHK038 Is “no secret persistence in Verdict artifacts” consistent with using an already-configured live gateway? [Consistency, Spec §FR-010, plan.md]
- [x] CHK039 Are latency/scale NFRs intentionally deferred to plan, or still leaking as unstated demo expectations? [Gap, Clarify deferred NFRs]

## Dependencies & Assumptions

- [x] CHK040 Is the live gateway assumed (OmniRoute-compatible `/v1/models` + completions) documented as a dependency, not as optional degraded mode? [Dependency, plan.md, Spec §FR-014]
- [x] CHK041 Is the default freshness window (3600s unless operator declares otherwise) stated as an assumption rather than hidden in code? [Assumption, research.md R7]
- [x] CHK042 Are Hermes keyword routing and OmniRoute opaque auto-combo explicitly out of candidate set in the requirements, not only in research notes? [Assumption, Spec §Discovery model, FR-001a, FR-001d]

## Ambiguities & Conflicts

- [x] CHK043 Does any remaining “optional adapter” or “degraded mode” sentence contradict US5 live-required? [Conflict, Spec §US5 vs leftover assumptions]
- [x] CHK044 Is the named checker’s exact artifact still plan-level, and is that boundary stated so implement cannot treat “any JSON” as the check? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-011, plan.md named check]
- [x] CHK045 If pricing facts live on a different gateway path than `/models`, is that still “fetched published specs” or a gap? [Ambiguity, Spec §FR-001b, contract catalog row]
